claim_scope: Primary crystallographic determination (Dickinson & Pauling, J. Am. Chem. Soc. 45, 1466-1471, 1923; COD 1010993) establishes that 2H-MoS2 (molybdenite) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P 6_3/m m c (No. 194), with cell a = b = 3.15(2) Angstrom, c = 12.30(7) Angstrom, gamma = 120 deg — a layered hexagonal structure. Scope: the 2H polytype ONLY.

scientific_scope.polytype_boundary: This is 2H. The 3R polytype (space group R3m, c ~ 18.3 Angstrom) is a DISTINCT structure and must not be conflated; monolayer/few-layer forms are also out of scope.

locator.citation: Dickinson, R. G.; Pauling, L. J. Am. Chem. Soc. 45, 1466-1471 (1923)
